goal: BENCHMARK, design only. Judged against 'reference' (a pipeline published by Comfy-Org or the model vendor): the agent's stages must reach the same result with free models - the same kind of steps in the same order, each fed by the right earlier output, prompts that describe exactly what was asked, and a design that holds with every ? answered. Nothing is installed or run.

reference.source: Comfy-Org Applied 'Contact Sheet Workflow' steps 1-3 (structure; the template uses paid Nano Banana Pro + Kling FLF2V)
steps: model photo + outfit flat-lay -> one editorial still of her wearing it (multi-image edit)
editorial still -> N angle variations, same person and outfit
consecutive angle stills -> first-last-frame clips between them
must: the outfit is put on her in an image stage before any video
the angle stills come from the editorial still (stage:), not from the raw photos
video uses first+last frame between consecutive stills

turns.text: Here's a photo of my model and a flat-lay photo of an outfit. I want a short fashion video of her wearing that outfit: first a strong editorial photo of her in it, then several shots from different angles, then the shots joined into one smooth video that moves from angle to angle.
